Product Description

The RI30 KV260 is a compact frameless inner-rotor torque motor designed for high torque density applications. At just 40 g, it delivers up to 230 mN·m peak torque and features a Ø17 mm through-bore. It is well suited for quadruped robots, collaborative robot joints, robotic wrists, and precision medical systems requiring a balance of torque, size, and dynamic performance.


Core Data

Dimensions Ø38*14 mm
Through Bore Diameter Ø17 mm
Weight 40 g
Peak Torque 230 mN·m
No-Load Speed 6240 rpm

Product Highlights

Lightweight Design with High Torque Density Weighing only 40 g, the motor operates at 24 V and delivers up to 230 mN·m peak torque, providing high torque density in a compact form factor suitable for dynamic motion systems.
Large Through-Bore Architecture Despite its compact Ø38 mm outer diameter, the motor integrates a Ø17 mm through-bore, enabling efficient routing of cables, signal lines, or pneumatic tubing while supporting compact mechanical integration.
Frameless Design for Maximum Integration Flexibility The frameless architecture allows the motor’s electromagnetic core to be directly integrated into robotic structures, high-ratio gearboxes, or fully integrated servo modules, enabling highly efficient system-level packaging and reduced overall system size.
Low Cogging Torque for Smooth Operation Optimized low cogging torque reduces torque ripple across both low-speed and high-speed operation, ensuring smooth and precise performance in high-accuracy servo control applications.

CubeMars is a brand under Sanrui Intelligent (IPO in 2026), focused on robotic power systems. With 17 years of R&D experience, it fully designs and manufactures its product line in-house. The company specializes in compact high-torque planetary module and frameless motors, with an annual output of 6 million units and international certifications, widely used in humanoid robots and exoskeleton applications.
